mentions.note: took Belgrave into the lead over Birchfield on the last stage of the 1948 London to Brighton Relay; ran in the 1948 Olympic 5,000m heats (international debut); pictured with Len Herbert

photos.c: Len Herbert and Bill Lucas were often involved in battle royal. Len, who gained his international vest in 1946, invariably used to sit in on the taller, longer striding Bill, waiting to turn on his powerful sprint in the final stretch. But on this occasion, believed to be at Wimbledon Stadium in 1951, Bill held the sprinter at bay. W.E. "Bill "Lucas, DFC, made his international debut in the heats of the 1948 Olympic 5,000m.
